translation: The toe (趾) is the finger of the foot. It is named toe (趾) to distinguish it from the hand, and is commonly called the foot segment (足節). Its number of segments is the same as the bone segments of the hand. The round bone that protrudes as a knob on the inner side behind the proximal segment of the big toe is called the he bone (核骨), also called the he bone (覈骨), commonly called the guguai (孤拐).
